messages:
ops-bot: Alert: elevated cross-region retries detected; initial correlation indicates DNS TTL change + LB route oscillation. Severity flagged Sev2.
kevin-m: Seeing retries spike ~3.6x between 02:10-02:16 UTC. Many failures show TCP close during TLS handshake after DNS change.
tara-v: I dug into registrar changes — zone TTL was temporarily lowered during a certificate automation test at 02:05 UTC. That coincides with heavier DNS churn.
maria-g: LB logs show a burst of route updates exactly after the DNS TTL change; some nodes rebalanced and we observed short-lived path flaps. snippet: 
```
[2026-05-12T02:11:03Z] route-sync: apply route set id=rs-778 status=UPDATE prev=3 new=4
[2026-05-12T02:11:03Z] tls: handshake failed, reason=unexpected_message conn_id=14322
```
david-s: Repro: synthetic probe ap-east -> eu-north during window saw 502 + client retries. curl: 
```
$ curl -sv https://api.redwood.example/health --resolve api.redwood.example:443:52.23.14.7
* About to connect() to api.redwood.example port 443
*   Trying 52.23.14.7... connected.
* TLS handshake error: unexpected message
* Closing connection 0
```
kevin-m: Immediate action items: keep short and ownable.
- A1: Revert TTL experiment and restore baseline TTL. Owner: @tara-v. ETA: 1h. Ticket NET-4309.
- A2: Add backoff multiplier on LB client for DNS-triggered route flaps (temporary). Owner: @kevin-m. ETA: 3h.
- A3: Add telemetry to tag route updates with change-cause (dns/rollout/certbot). Owner: @maria-g. ETA: 72h. NET-4310.
- A4: Postmortem follow-up: recurring pattern detection for "dns-ttl->route-oscillation->tls-retry" chain. Owner: @david-s. ETA: 2 weeks.
tara-v: TTL reverted and propagation monitored. ops-bot: DNS TTL restored to 300s.
maria-g: I'll instrument a small label in route-sync events to include dns-event-id and rollout-id so we can correlate. Will open NET-4310 with implementation details.
david-s: I'll add a query to anomaly-monitoring that flags this pattern and schedule a monthly run. Also propose a short runbook: if cross-region retries >2x and recent DNS TTL change, throttle route applies for 5s. Owner: @david-s. ETA: 1 week.
kevin-m: Hotfix note: backoff multiplier applied to 40% traffic for immediate relief. Expect reduced retry amplification; may increase tail latency slightly.
tara-v: Adding note: certificate automation tests should never change zone TTL during production windows. Filing infra policy doc change. Owner: @tara-v. ETA: 5 days.
maria-g: Observability: will add dashboard card for "route_apply_rate" and correlate with "dns_ttl_change_events". Owner: @maria-g. ETA: 48h.
kevin-m: Recurring incident comment: this is unlike pure sni double-apply cases; here the chain starts with DNS-level TTL experiment. We should keep these as a distinct postmortem category.
ops-bot: Incident update: mitigation applied (TTL restored, client backoff in place). Monitoring window open for 2h. Severity: Sev2. Further updates will be posted to this thread.
